packageName: PPA Connect Smart (Tuya Garage Door) Local
author: Ricardo Nogueira Garcia
releaseNotes: v1.0.0: first release. Local driver (port 6668, protocols 3.3, 3.4 and 3.5, no Tuya Cloud) for the PPA Connect Smart Wi-Fi module (Tuya category ckmkzq) on PPA Agility controllers: door state from DP 10 / DP 3, single pulse command, travel time, and one Invert state option for modules that report open and closed swapped.

drivers.name: PPA Connect Smart (Tuya Garage Door) Local

x-catalog.description: Local driver for the PPA Connect Smart Wi-Fi module (Tuya garage door opener, category ckmkzq) used on skylights and gates: door state, pulse command and an invert-state option, with no Tuya Cloud.
